correctness.rationale: For every fixed real B>1, invariance and normalization follow from a convergent Parry step-density series. The first left-branch time is log_B(1/epsilon)+O_B(1), and every preceding weighted missing interval has exact mass epsilon/B. The subsequent weighted tail is O_B(epsilon), proving the rescaled signed weak limit. Variation upper bound plus the weak lower semicontinuity yields the exact L1 coefficient. The standalone checker tests 12 high-precision parameter configurations; numerical tests are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The boundary between one full and two full branches is a natural phase interface for double-base dynamics. A signed delta-at-endpoint response and exact positive epsilon log(1/epsilon) variation coefficient are a structural asymptotic not determined by standard existence theory or generic stability upper bounds; they expose optimal non-Lipschitz response in an explicitly solvable family.
